patch.value: Reconcile todo.txt editing sessions without overwriting concurrent edits

Export todo.txt with stable item and field digests; reconcile external edits against current tracker values using fidelity conversion. Overlap rechecked: pm-todos fidelity/upsert owns todo.txt conversion; pm-csv owns tables and core SDK transactions own atomicity. No existing editing-session item found; reconciliation PR 140 items excluded.

Concurrent local edits conflict explicitly; deleting a line never deletes an item by default; unchanged imports are idempotent; typed SDK and CLI with compact TOON/JSON and actionable refusals; non-git and public-tracker-copy validation

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: todo.txt lines carry stable pm identities; versioned sidecar carries item and field digests. Three-way field reconciliation reuses fidelity conversion; omissions retain items, unchanged imports write nothing. Final reconciliation runs inside the core SDK item lock, retaining ownership, workflow and history enforcement. Batch atomicity remains a core concern; result records per-item progress if a writer races later rows. Lifecycle changes require normal pm close/reopen and return a typed remedy. No git subprocess is required.

Source fingerprints stayed unchanged. Behavioral revert: disabling only field-digest conflict detection makes the three-way regression fail (exit 1); restored implementation passes.
